how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:fishing-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1579:obj:0: Bring 8 ⟦E1⟧ to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1579:details:0: I came to Auberdine because of the quiet. I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:1579:details:1: So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way. I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard! I need my gaffer jacks!
rows.quest:1579:details:2: I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
rows.quest:1579:progress:0: Did you find my gaffer jacks, ⟦1⟧? Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
rows.quest:1579:completion:0: I can't believe you found them! You must be the luckiest ⟦2⟧ in ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:1580:obj:0: Bring 12 ⟦E4⟧ to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1580:details:0: We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:1580:details:1: One night I was wandering the roads of ⟦E5⟧. I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine. My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone! I must have dropped them in the water!
rows.quest:1580:details:2: I need those electropellers! Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in ⟦E5⟧...
rows.quest:1580:progress:0: Did you find any electropellers? I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
rows.quest:1580:completion:0: I can't believe it! You found them! You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!
rows.quest:1580:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦4⟧. And here, take these. Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.
rows.quest:6607:obj:0: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
rows.quest:6607:obj:1: ⟦E6⟧ from the Misty Reed Strand in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:2: BA ⟦E8⟧ from the Sar'theris Strand in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:5: Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!
rows.quest:6607:details:0: Can't say I really enjoy fishin' much. Figure I been at it for a good 20 or 30 years now.
rows.quest:6607:details:1: I reckon people are driven to do what they do for different reasons.
rows.quest:6607:details:2: Now, I'm not saying you need to fish for 30 years or catch every fish in the sea to become a master fisherman. I reckon you just need to be determined - determined enough to sit on your duff for hours at a time, doin' nothin'.
rows.quest:6607:details:3: I'll tell you what, catch me a few rare fish and I'll teach you a thing or two. Here's a list:
rows.quest:6607:completion:1: Come over here, lemme show you how to set a few lines.
rows.quest:6608:obj:0: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of ⟦E14⟧ (at least that's what you think Lumak said).
rows.quest:6608:details:0: Lumak no can teach ⟦5⟧ no more. You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.
rows.quest:6608:details:1: You find Nat in ⟦E15⟧, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. Nat probably fishing. Go now!
rows.quest:6608:completion:0: 'Course, you must be a friend of Lumak's.
rows.quest:6608:completion:1: Fishin'? I can tell you all 'bout fishin'.
rows.quest:6609:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E3⟧, to the coastal city of ⟦E14⟧. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!
rows.quest:6609:details:0: I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, ⟦6⟧! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.
rows.quest:6609:details:1: I got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!
rows.quest:6609:details:2: Don't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on ⟦E3⟧ who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' ⟦E14⟧. Git goin'!
rows.quest:6609:completion:0: I've always got room on my island for visitors... I reckon...
rows.quest:8193:progress:0: Today between 2pm and 4pm we have a contest to determine who the greatest angler of them all is! Just be the FIRST PERSON to bring me 40 Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coast of Stranglethorn before anyone else does and you will be declared the ⟦E17⟧!⟦7⟧⟦8⟧If you are not the first person to bring me 40 fish, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for each 5 Tastyfish you bring her.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly!
rows.quest:8193:completion:0: Hurry up and turn those in if you want to be declared the ⟦E17⟧! I have been standing around here for HOURS with nothing to eat! Hand those suckers over!
